item.title: Meduza: 355 Ukrainian drones flew toward Moscow overnight, prompting flight restrictions at two airports
item.description: Moscow Mayor Sergei Sobyanin said 355 Ukrainian drones flew toward the capital overnight on November 24. Air defense forces shot down most of the drones “at distant approaches” and destroyed 63 more as they approached Moscow, he said on his Telegram channel.
